description: Counts properties matching locations and filters (provide locations, filters, include_lists or exclude_lists), such as is_corporate_owned for corporation, LLC or business owners, or with anchor=people their matching contacts. Use the same anchor, contact_audience and require_phone as the search. Needs a connected DealMachine account; counting consumes no credits.

active_phones_only.description: Count only contacts with an active reported phone number

contact_audience.description: Required for anchor=people; cannot be none

exclude_lists.description: Remove records in any excluded list, including records in included lists.

include_lists.description: Return records in any included list. Can be combined with exclude_lists.

landline_only.description: Count only contacts with a landline phone number

items.description: Search area. Locations OR together across the array.

code.description: state (2-letter), county (5-digit FIPS), city (place ID), or zip_code

mobile_only.description: Count only contacts with a wireless phone number

require_email.description: Count only contacts with an email address

require_phone.description: With anchor=people, count only contacts with a phone

scrub_dnc.description: Count only contacts with a phone not on the Do Not Call registry

name: dealmachine_property_count
